title: Record Deletion Tool for Business Central in AppSource
summary: A Record Deletion Tool for Business Central is now available on AppSource as a free extension to clean up test data. The tool includes extensibility features allowing developers to add custom tables and handle protected tables through subscriber functions and codeunits with appropriate permissions.
key_points: Free AppSource extension ported from the original Dynamics NAV Record Deletion tool
Allows cleanup of test transactions in a company
Extensible via event subscribers to add custom tables to deletion suggestions
Developers can handle protected tables using separate codeunits with delete permissions

quotes.text: In addition, it is now also extendable, you can add code to make your own tables defaults in the suggestion of what to delete.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key new capability that allows customization for organization-specific tables
